gate: Most people taste a subject. This code chews it. The drive is to go down past the surface of a thing, past the second layer, past the layer where most listeners are already satisfied, until the bottom is touched. It is not curiosity, exactly. Curiosity skips. This is closer to a slow downward pressure, the body's refusal to leave a subject until the foundation under it has been felt. The misread is that this is intellectual. It is not. Depth here is splenic, instinctive, an animal sense for where the rot is and where the load-bearing beams actually live. Reading more books does not feed it. Sitting longer with one question does. The fear that comes attached is the fear of not knowing enough, the quiet conviction that the bottom has still not been reached, that one more layer is hiding. The work is to notice when enough has been found.
centre_field: The spleen is the body's intuition centre, the immune system of the energy field, the part that registers in the present moment whether something is safe or off. Depth lives here because depth, in this system, is not a mental operation. It is a felt sense. The spleen reads what is actually under a thing the way the nose reads what is under a smell. That placement is the teaching. Knowledge collected from the head goes stale and stacks up. Knowledge dredged through the body lands as instinct and stays usable forever. The same centre that holds this code also holds the fear of inadequacy, the low background hum of not yet being ready. The two are not separate. The fear is the cost of caring about the bottom of things. Soothing it with more research only sharpens the hum. The way through is to trust what the body has already understood.
channel: Depth alone is a well no one drinks from. This code reaches toward the gate of skills, the throat-side voice that turns understanding into something a person can actually use, hear, watch, or copy. Without that reach, the depth pools. The pattern is familiar. Years of slow descent into a subject, real mastery sitting there in the body, and no shape on the outside that anyone else can recognise. The throat partner is what gives the depth a form, a craft, a teachable surface. What this side lacks alone is articulation, and articulation here is not just talking. It is the conversion of instinctive understanding into a performance, a sentence, a meal, a piece of work that carries the depth out where it can land. Joined, the two become talent. Apart, the depth is private weather.
